usage: The word 面巾 (min6 gan1) is a noun that refers to a small towel used for drying your face.
You can use 面巾 when talking about personal hygiene or bathroom items.
When pluralizing 面巾, you can add quantifiers like 一塊 (jat1 faai3) to refer to one face towel.
面巾 is often mentioned together with other towels like 浴巾 (bath towel) or 手巾 (hand towel).
It is commonly used in daily conversation when discussing washing your face or cleaning.
